# Commands

<!-- Generated by build/Update-Docs.ps1 from the comment-based help in Public/. Do not edit by hand. -->

This section has one page for each win32-toolkit command. Use these pages when you need every option of a command. The guide explains each task step by step.

Each page comes from the help that is built into the command. You can read the same text offline: run `Get-Help <command> -Full` in PowerShell.

## Start and package

- [Show-Win32Toolkit](Show-Win32Toolkit.md): Starts the win32-toolkit menu, where you do every task step by step.
- [Invoke-Win32Toolkit](Invoke-Win32Toolkit.md): Packages an app from winget, from the download to an optional test, build and publish.
- [New-Win32ToolkitManualApp](New-Win32ToolkitManualApp.md): Creates a project from your own installer, for an app that is not in winget.
- [Complete-Win32ToolkitManualApp](Complete-Win32ToolkitManualApp.md): Runs the install capture of a project again, then the tests, build and publish you ask for.

## Test

- [Test-Win32ToolkitProject](Test-Win32ToolkitProject.md): Tests a project in Windows Sandbox or the Hyper-V test VM and records the result.

## Build and publish

- [Export-Win32ToolkitIntuneWin](Export-Win32ToolkitIntuneWin.md): Checks a project and builds its .intunewin package, and can publish it to Intune.
- [Publish-Win32ToolkitIntuneApp](Publish-Win32ToolkitIntuneApp.md): Uploads a .intunewin package to Intune as a new Win32 app.
- [Export-Win32ToolkitDocumentation](Export-Win32ToolkitDocumentation.md): Writes a one-page summary of a packaged app for your customer.

## Intune sign-in

- [Connect-Win32ToolkitIntune](Connect-Win32ToolkitIntune.md): Signs in to Intune and shows which tenant you are connected to.
- [Disconnect-Win32ToolkitIntune](Disconnect-Win32ToolkitIntune.md): Signs out of the Intune session that win32-toolkit uses.

## Dependencies and prior installs

- [Set-Win32ToolkitAppDependency](Set-Win32ToolkitAppDependency.md): Sets the apps that Intune must install before this app.
- [Sync-Win32ToolkitAppDependency](Sync-Win32ToolkitAppDependency.md): Updates the dependencies of an app that is already in Intune, without publishing it again.
- [Set-Win32ToolkitPriorInstall](Set-Win32ToolkitPriorInstall.md): Lists, adds, changes or removes the prior-install rules of a project.

## Hyper-V test VM

- [New-Win32ToolkitTestVM](New-Win32ToolkitTestVM.md): Builds the Hyper-V test VM once, from a Windows 11 ISO or your own virtual disk.
- [Set-Win32ToolkitTestVMResource](Set-Win32ToolkitTestVMResource.md): Changes the processors and memory of the Hyper-V test VM and takes a new clean checkpoint.
- [Reset-Win32ToolkitTestVM](Reset-Win32ToolkitTestVM.md): Puts the Hyper-V test VM back to its clean checkpoint.
- [Remove-Win32ToolkitTestVM](Remove-Win32ToolkitTestVM.md): Deletes the Hyper-V test VM and, if you ask, its disk files.
